# Set Up

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
})

base_dir <- rprojroot::find_root(
  rprojroot::has_dir("AD_CR_HRS"), path = getwd()
)
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "AD_CR_HRS")
save_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "analysis-results", "ADNI")
```

# Load Data

```{r load}
adni_data <- readRDS(
  file.path(save_dir, "ADNI_2025_MCI_future_data.rds")
)
mrs_df <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(save_dir, "EAP_MRS_scores.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

# Analyze

## Standardize Data

MRS and baseline age are standardized once per participant in the pooled
dataset, using the same procedure as the previous file. These z-scores
are retained when the data are divided into MRS groups.

```{r standardize_data}
stat_df <- adni_data$longitudinal_df %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    mrs_df %>%
      dplyr::select("sample_id", "MRS_raw", "mrs"),
    by = c("sample" = "sample_id"),
    relationship = "many-to-one",
    na_matches = "never"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    RID = factor(.data$RID),
    PHC_Sex = factor(.data$PHC_Sex)
  )

zval_df <- stat_df %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$RID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mrs_z = as.numeric(scale(.data$mrs)),
    baseline_age_z = as.numeric(scale(.data$baseline_age))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select("RID", "mrs_z", "baseline_age_z")

stat_df <- stat_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    zval_df,
    by = "RID",
    relationship = "many-to-one",
    na_matches = "never"
  )

stopifnot(
  setequal(unique(as.character(stat_df$RID)),
           as.character(adni_data$pheno_df$RID))
)
```

## Add High and Low MRS Groups

The cutoff is the participant-level median MRS z-score among participants
with at least one complete, finite model observation.

- **Low MRS** includes values at or below the median;
- **High MRS** includes values above the median.

Every usable visit from a participant receives the same MRS group. Tied
values remain together, so the groups may differ in size. MRS retains the
original pooled participant-level z-score scale, and baseline pTau retains
the scale used in the input data.

```{r baseline_mrs_groups}
model_columns <- c(
  "PHC_MEM",
  "baseline_age_z",
  "PHC_Sex",
  "APOE4",
  "PHC_Education",
  "mrs_z",
  "baseline_pTau",
  "time",
  "RID"
)
missing_columns <- setdiff(model_columns, names(stat_df))
if (length(missing_columns)) {
  stop("Missing model columns: ", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "))
}

# Remove unusable visits; retain a participant's other usable visits.
mrs_model_df <- stat_df[
  stats::complete.cases(stat_df[, model_columns, drop = FALSE]),
  , drop = FALSE
]
numeric_columns <- model_columns[vapply(
  mrs_model_df[, model_columns, drop = FALSE], is.numeric, logical(1)
)]
for (column in numeric_columns) {
  mrs_model_df <- mrs_model_df[
    is.finite(mrs_model_df[[column]]), , drop = FALSE
  ]
}
mrs_model_df <- droplevels(mrs_model_df)
if (!nrow(mrs_model_df)) stop("No complete, finite model observations.")
if (any(mrs_model_df$time < 0)) {
  stop("Negative follow-up times found. Check the definition of time.")
}

baseline_check <- mrs_model_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$RID) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_ptau = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$baseline_pTau),
    n_mrs = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$mrs_z),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
if (any(baseline_check$n_ptau != 1L | baseline_check$n_mrs != 1L)) {
  stop("Baseline pTau or MRS varies within RID. Resolve baseline duplicates first.")
}

mrs_participants <- mrs_model_df %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data$RID, .data$time) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$RID, .keep_all = TRUE)
if (nrow(mrs_participants) < 2L) {
  stop("At least two participants are needed to define high and low MRS groups.")
}
mrs_median <- stats::median(mrs_participants$mrs_z)
if (!is.finite(mrs_median)) stop("The MRS median is not finite.")
mrs_levels <- c("Low MRS", "High MRS")
mrs_participants$MRS_group <- factor(
  ifelse(mrs_participants$mrs_z <= mrs_median, "Low MRS", "High MRS"),
  levels = mrs_levels
)
if (any(table(mrs_participants$MRS_group) == 0L)) {
  stop("The median split produced an empty MRS group. Inspect the MRS distribution.")
}

mrs_model_df <- mrs_model_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    dplyr::select(mrs_participants, "RID", "MRS_group"),
    by = "RID", relationship = "many-to-one", na_matches = "never"
  )

knitr::kable(
  data.frame(percentile = "50th percentile (median)", mrs_z = mrs_median),
  digits = 4, caption = "Participant-level MRS z-score median cutoff"
)
```

## Divide Data into Two Datasets

```{r split_datasets}
mrs_low_df <- mrs_model_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$MRS_group == "Low MRS") %>%
  droplevels()
mrs_high_df <- mrs_model_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$MRS_group == "High MRS") %>%
  droplevels()

mrs_datasets <- setNames(list(mrs_low_df, mrs_high_df), mrs_levels)
mrs_group_summary <- mrs_model_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$MRS_group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_participants = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$RID),
    n_observations = dplyr::n(),
    max_time_years = max(.data$time),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    mrs_participants %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.data$MRS_group) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        MRS_z_min = min(.data$mrs_z),
        MRS_z_median = stats::median(.data$mrs_z),
        MRS_z_max = max(.data$mrs_z),
        pTau_min = min(.data$baseline_pTau),
        pTau_median = stats::median(.data$baseline_pTau),
        pTau_max = max(.data$baseline_pTau),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "MRS_group", relationship = "one-to-one"
  )

knitr::kable(
  mrs_group_summary, digits = 3,
  caption = "Participants, usable visits, and predictor ranges in each MRS dataset"
)
```

# Save

```{r save}
saveRDS(
  list(
    mrs_model_df = mrs_model_df,
    mrs_participants = mrs_participants,
    mrs_median = mrs_median,
    mrs_levels = mrs_levels,
    mrs_low_df = mrs_low_df,
    mrs_high_df = mrs_high_df,
    mrs_datasets = mrs_datasets,
    mrs_group_summary = mrs_group_summary
  ),
  file.path(save_dir, "ADNI_Split.rds")
)
cat("Saved:", file.path(save_dir, "ADNI_Split.rds"), "\n")
```
